parameters.name: job.inp
parameters.content:
! PBE0 def2-TZVP NMR NoAutoStart
%maxcore 192
%scf
  MaxIter 256
  AutoTRAH false
end
%elprop
  Nuclei = all
end
* xyzfile 0 1 geom.xyz

goal_giao_shielding.gap: requires the prepared_geometry artifact and job.inp artifact; add orca.run after both receipts are available

goal_delivery.gap: requires completed GIAO shielding output and observations.json; add analysis/report step after ORCA receipt

goal_random_seed.gap: record seed 1701 in the final report; structure.prepare will be treated as deterministic unless a random procedure is identified

proposal.reason: Initial plan first resolves the HCN identity, prepares and saves the fixed geometry, and writes the actual ORCA input with PBE0/def2-TZVP, NMR, %maxcore 192, SCF MaxIter 256, AutoTRAH false, and the required NoAutoStart keyword. The ORCA consuming step cannot be added until the prepared_geometry and job.inp artifacts have real artifact_id/sha256 receipts; after those execute I will revise the plan to bind them, then add parsing/reporting.
